source.title: Alveolar osteitis associated with methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus epidermidis

semantic_spot_checks.source: Page 221 reports resolution seven days after AO management; page 222 says azithromycin resistance suggested spontaneous resolution without antibiotic influence.
semantic_spot_checks.artifact: Atoms preserve the day-seven clinical resolution as a source finding and keep the spontaneous-resolution statement as an author_conclusion rather than a measured treatment effect.

semantic_spot_checks.source: AO was diagnosed four days after extraction; follow-up resolution was reported seven days after AO management.
semantic_spot_checks.artifact: Both timepoints are preserved in source-anchored atoms without converting them into comparative effect estimates.

semantic_spot_checks.source: The microbiologic specimen was collected from the pulpal chamber/root canals before extraction; AO was diagnosed four days later.
semantic_spot_checks.artifact: ATOM preserves the sampling site and timing. SEA explicitly treats this as a causal-attribution limitation.

semantic_spot_checks.source: Figure 2 caption reports a naked socket, necrotic tissue, and marginal gingivitis.
semantic_spot_checks.artifact: A figure-anchored qualitative_result atom and the SEA Figure 2 block represent the same finding.

source_integrity_notes: The microbiologic sample was collected from the pulpal chamber and root canals before extraction, not from the alveolar socket when postoperative AO was diagnosed. ATOM does not convert the authors causal framing into direct proof that MRSE caused AO.

The report lists ten antibiotics tested but gives explicit resistance calls only for erythromycin, azithromycin, clarithromycin, and trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole. The output does not infer susceptibility for the other agents.
Cefixime and azithromycin doses, routes, and frequencies are not reported. Those fields remain absent.
The source spells sulfamethoxazole and trimethoprim inconsistently in places. Canonical statements normalize the drug name while source excerpts preserve the printed wording.
No dedicated funding, conflict-of-interest, or data-availability statement was identified in the supplied four pages. No such atom was invented.
All model-extracted atoms remain needs_review because no independent human reviewer step is represented.
